# Index

Gives each splat, point or mesh vertex its position in the current list, starting at zero.

`lfs.index` · Input

## How to use

Use with Math or Compare to select numbered elements.\
Deleting or joining geometry can change these numbers.

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Index | `Index` | lfs.int | — | — | Current list position, starting at 0. Joining or deleting geometry can renumber elements. |
